verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an official MCP server and CLI that let an AI agent create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and draft messages. Broadcasts can also be queued to send at a specified time. However, nothing documents a draft or pending-approval state that holds an agent-built campaign until a human approves the send. The MCP read/write permission split governs approval of the agent's tool calls, not approval of a campaign before send. Missing for 10: documented draft or approval workflow for agent-created campaigns, explicit scheduling of a send by the agent, hands-on or independent corroboration.
